propositions: The bridge runner must execute identically across local shells, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments through a single packaged Python entrypoint at rebar bridge run without requiring repository-local runner scripts.
Legacy reconcile callers and checked-out workflows invoking rebar reconcile --mode must retain their behavior, defaults, exit codes, and published outputs without breakage.

Provider-neutral destructive-repair pause ownership must be implemented through a durable git-ref-based CAS mechanism in _repair_pause.py that reads existing pause snapshots, calls set_pause, and releases only its observed OID through release(..., GATE_REF, ...) without GitHub CLI dependency.
The destructive repair surfaces at fsck.py and doctor.py must route through the provider-neutral _repair_pause.py ownership contract to enforce schedule safety across all invocation contexts.

Regression test test_repair_pause_ownership.py must prove no GitHub CLI dependency by intercepting subprocess argv for 'gh' calls, running destructive repair successfully, and asserting zero gh_calls.
GitHub-specific mirror health (mirror_guard.py) and optional step-summary reporting remain unchanged and outside bridge execution scope.
